```{python}
#| include: false

import pandas as pd
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

from plotnine import (
    ggplot, aes, geom_col, geom_text,
    labs, theme_minimal, theme,
    scale_fill_manual, scale_y_continuous,
    expand_limits, element_text,
    element_line, element_blank
)

# Load Palmer Penguins dataset
penguins = load_penguins()

# Remove missing species and island information
clean = penguins.dropna(
    subset=["species", "island"]
)

# Species distribution
species_counts = (
    clean.groupby("species")
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="observations")
)

# Island distribution
island_counts = (
    clean.groupby("island")
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="observations")
)

# Species distribution across islands
island_species = (
    clean.groupby(["island", "species"])
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="observations")
)

# Summary statistics
total_penguins = len(clean)
total_species = clean["species"].nunique()
total_islands = clean["island"].nunique()

# Blue palette for species
species_colors = {
    "Adelie": "#173F73",
    "Chinstrap": "#438CCB",
    "Gentoo": "#91C9F2"
}

# Blue palette for islands
island_colors = {
    "Biscoe": "#173F73",
    "Dream": "#438CCB",
    "Torgersen": "#91C9F2"
}

# Consistent chart typography and styling
chart_theme = (
    theme_minimal()
    + theme(
        text=element_text(
            family="Lato",
            color="#263B50"
        ),
        plot_title=element_text(
            size=15,
            weight="bold",
            color="#173F73"
        ),
        axis_title=element_text(
            size=11,
            weight="bold",
            color="#173F73"
        ),
        axis_text=element_text(
            size=10,
            color="#40566D"
        ),
        legend_title=element_text(
            size=10,
            weight="bold",
            color="#173F73"
        ),
        legend_text=element_text(
            size=9,
            color="#40566D"
        ),
        panel_grid_major=element_line(
            color="#E5EEF7"
        ),
        panel_grid_minor=element_blank(),
        plot_background=element_blank(),
        figure_size=(9, 5)
    )
)
```

```{python}
# content: valuebox

dict(

## Species Distribution

```{python}
#| title: "Penguin Observations by Species"

(
    ggplot(
        species_counts,
        aes(
            x="species",
            y="observations",
            fill="species"
        )
    )
    + geom_col(width=0.65)
    + geom_text(
        aes(label="observations"),
        va="bottom",
        nudge_y=3,
        size=10,
        color="#173F73"
    )
    + scale_fill_manual(
        values=species_colors
    )
    + scale_y_continuous(
        expand=(0, 0)
    )
    + expand_limits(
        y=species_counts["observations"].max() * 1.12
    )
    + labs(
        title="Number of Observations per Species",
        x="Penguin Species",
        y="Number of Observations",
        fill="Species"
    )
    + chart_theme
)
```

**Interpretation:**

Adelie penguins have the highest number of observations, with 152 recorded penguins, followed by Gentoo with 124 and Chinstrap with 68. This indicates that Adelie is the most frequently represented species in the Palmer Penguins dataset. The results show that the three species have different observation counts.

## Island Distribution

```{python}
#| title: "Total Penguin Observations by Island"

(
    ggplot(
        island_counts,
        aes(
            x="island",
            y="observations",
            fill="island"
        )
    )
    + geom_col(width=0.65)
    + geom_text(
        aes(label="observations"),
        va="bottom",
        nudge_y=3,
        size=10,
        color="#173F73"
    )
    + scale_fill_manual(
        values=island_colors
    )
    + scale_y_continuous(
        expand=(0, 0)
    )
    + expand_limits(
        y=island_counts["observations"].max() * 1.12
    )
    + labs(
        title="Number of Penguins per Island",
        x="Island",
        y="Number of Observations",
        fill="Island"
    )
    + chart_theme
)
```

**Interpretation:**

Biscoe Island has the highest number of recorded penguins, with 168 observations, followed by Dream Island with 124 and Torgersen Island with 52. This shows that Biscoe Island has the largest representation in the dataset. The observations are distributed differently across the three islands.

## Species Distribution Across Islands

```{python}
#| title: "Penguin Species Across Different Islands"

(
    ggplot(
        island_species,
        aes(
            x="island",
            y="observations",
            fill="species"
        )
    )
    + geom_col(width=0.65)
    + scale_fill_manual(
        values=species_colors
    )
    + labs(
        title="Distribution of Penguin Species Across Islands",
        x="Island",
        y="Number of Observations",
        fill="Penguin Species"
    )
    + chart_theme
    + theme(
        legend_position="right"
    )
)
```

**Interpretation:**

Adelie penguins are recorded on all three islands, while Gentoo penguins are found only on Biscoe Island and Chinstrap penguins only on Dream Island. Biscoe has both Adelie and Gentoo penguins, while Dream has Adelie and Chinstrap penguins. This demonstrates that the distribution of penguin species varies depending on the island.
```
